subject.title: feat(wizard): deliver progress over the RPC wizard protocol

question: Should core tolerate progress-step answers from existing RPC wizard clients, or may this PR require every client to re-poll `wizard.next` without an answer for progress steps?
rationale: The PR changes a client-visible wizard protocol behavior and current bundled clients still answer progress-like steps, so maintainers need to choose the compatibility contract before merge.

options.title: Preserve Progress-Answering Clients
options.body: Treat progress answers as a harmless advance or update bundled clients before broad emission so existing clients do not fail during onboarding.

options.title: Accept The No-Answer Contract
options.body: Require clients to re-poll without answering progress steps and document/roll out that compatibility break intentionally.

options.title: Pause For Umbrella Protocol Direction
options.body: Wait for the broader wizard RPC parity issue to settle progress semantics before landing this focused branch.

recommendation.title: Preserve Progress-Answering Clients
recommendation.body: Treat progress answers as a harmless advance or update bundled clients before broad emission so existing clients do not fail during onboarding.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent onboarding and Crestodian history makes this the best available routing owner for the client-visible wizard compatibility decision.
